purpose: State-scoped coverage inventory for Kentucky 2024 result, review, turnout, map, historical, and election-administration context sources. This inventory records source availability and blockers; it does not promote production data and does not allege fraud or misconduct.
authorityPriority: Official Kentucky State Board of Elections, county clerks, county boards of elections, official GIS/Census, EAC, and official court/board records first; secondary sources are context only and caveated.

The generated county reconciliation reports 2,086,320 State Board voters versus 2,086,090 EAC fallback ballots cast, a 230-voter State Board minus EAC delta across 85 county rows, with no registered-voter denominator delta.
The reconciliation is retained as provenance and request planning context only; it is not an active turnout replacement.
